_note: NPC (docs/ART-REDO.md section 4). The concept sheets have no merchant, so the box is the theme.jpg wheat and the stone beside it for the sack colours, and the source_note says so. type is monster because a figure that is not a seated hero is asset.json on that path. World height 32 is a person, 88 px; the cell is 128. Clips are idle on S W N E and no walk. v-S is a slight three-quarter turn, recorded for the final review: views only scales the figure, so that facing is not a retake. After the still-idle floor every idle passes: idle-S start 2 step 51 floor 12; idle-W start 6 step 20 floor 8; idle-N start 1 step 8 floor 34; idle-E start 3 step 1 floor 7. The check uses the built sheet. Face is the skin in the top 30% (lightness over 0.58, hue 20 to 40). S holds 66 to 73 of those pixels, so the floor is 40. N holds 0 to 3, so the ceiling is 4. The snapshot sends the merchant when his chunk is discovered. The hermit stays off.
source_note: The reference shows no merchant: it is wheat and a stone wall; draw one merchant and nothing else, no wheat, no wall and no torch; use the reference only for the colours of the sacks and the coat
